briefHtml:
NAV S$10,360,104 (watcher -0.56%; listed -2.91% — stale baseline, see notes)

  • Biggest mover (Fri, verified): Intel +19.4% to $79.77 as Oracle's cloud beat reignited the AI-infrastructure trade (Dell +12%, HPE +12%). In-book: silver miners ground lower (SILJ ~-2% to $30.55); SMIC fell a 4th straight day to HK$63.15 (-10% in two weeks).
  • The one thing: Wednesday's FOMC (~2am SGT Thu) is an ~87-90% priced hike after Friday's hot core CPI (+0.3% m/m vs +0.2% exp). Warsh faces a live oil shock (WTI ~$100, record diesel >$6, Houthis seized Perim Island) with the 10y just below 5%.

Watcher flags: 5 critical — all stale-baseline artifacts

  • Verified Friday moves: SMIC -0.47% (63.15), Xiaomi +1.70% (26.36), Tencent +0.66% (428.40), CDL -0.93% (8.50), SILJ ~-2% (30.55; NAV -0.50%), SIL +0.17% (SLVP proxy). The '-6%/-7.3% in a day' flags compare vs ~Sep 4 closes, not Friday.
  • Real drift since Sep 4: SMIC -10% in 2 weeks, SILJ -3.6%, CDL ~-5% from early-Sep highs. Slow bleed, not crash.
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2672; implied USDCNY ~6.70 (CNY strength flatters the CNY cash piles). priceErrors: L46.SI feed still down.

Insider trades (SGX/HK, 7d)

  • None found for held names Sep 7-14 (SGXNet/web + HKEX checks; Seatrium IR page shows nothing since June). None surfaced is not proof of absence.

Congress trades

  • Zero filings — BeltwayIQ week-37 (Sep 7-13) closed at 0 filings / 0 members / ~$0k. Source
  • Capitol Trades shows an undated 5-trade cluster from Rep. Cisneros (D-CA): sold AMD, APP; bought AGIO, APH, APG — all $1k-15k, below the $50k alert threshold. Source

Policy watch

  • FOMC Wed: hot core CPI pushed hike odds to ~87-90%; RSM expects ≥2 more hikes over 12m. Fed in blackout — statement + dots are the only signals. Yahoo
  • Iran: Houthis seized Perim Island (Red Sea) Fri; Saudi East-West pipeline temporarily closed after drone attack; US restricted Hormuz air-defence slots; Tehran rejects talks unless all demands met. Timeline
  • Canada: 50% tariffs on additional Canadian goods effective tomorrow Sep 15 — one day before the FOMC; Canada's C$27.6bn counter-tariffs live since Sep 8. Blakes

Market context (~07:45 SGT)

  • US Fri: S&P 7,656.98 (+0.86%), Dow 52,573.29 (+0.98%), Nasdaq 26,333.04 (+0.96%) — all down on the week. VIX 15.84 (-11.2%).
  • 10y just below 5% (highest since Oct 2023); gold ~$4,380 (Fri low $4,318); silver $64.61 (+0.5% vs Fri settle $64.284); WTI ~$100, Brent ~$104, diesel record >$6.

Risk

  • Binary event: Wed FOMC 87-90% priced to hike; VIX 15.84 prices neither tail. Hawkish hike → 10y through 5%, metals + HK tech hit together; surprise hold → violent relief rally. Gap lands ~2am SGT Thu.
  • Silver line: 1,777 oz vs ~S$56,240 loan ≈ 1.5x; equity ~S$89.2k at $64.61. Flush to $60 = -11.6% equity; no margin danger, but carry rises with every hike.
  • Oil-stagflation loop tightening into the Fed: Perim Island + Saudi pipeline closure + record diesel feed September CPI. Concentration: metals complex = dominant factor bet. FX: ~35% non-SGD. 62% idle cash = the hedge and the powder.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • US 10y/TIPS (Defense 15% vs ~0%): post-FOMC 10y ≥5.0% = trigger to start building duration into peak-hike pricing; scale in tranches.
  • Silver/SLVP/SILJ (Real assets 20% vs ~4%): hike + $62-64 holding = reload zone (sell-rumor-buy-news); clean break of $60 = wait. Leveraged line = no urgency.
  • SMIC/Tencent/Xiaomi (Asia 10% vs ~3%; AI 15% vs ~1%): US AI-infra ripped Friday while SMIC hit HK$63.15 (-16.7% from Aug 18, consensus target ~94). Wednesday is the trigger either way; staggered small tranches.

trumpWatch.title: FOMC Wednesday: hike odds ~87-90% after hot core CPI
trumpWatch.detail: August core CPI +0.3% m/m (vs +0.2% expected; 2.4% y/y), headline 3.4% y/y. CME FedWatch ~87-90% for a 25bp hike on Sep 16 (decision ~2am SGT Thu). Chair Warsh: underlying inflation hasn't 'meaningfully improved'. RSM expects at least two more hikes over the next year. Fed in blackout since Sep 5.

trumpWatch.title: Iran war opens new front — Houthis seize Perim Island; Saudi pipeline shut
trumpWatch.detail: Sep 11: Houthis retook Perim Island at the Red Sea's southern entrance; Saudi Arabia temporarily closed its East-West crude pipeline after a drone attack from Iraq. Sep 12: US restricted air-defence time slots for Hormuz transits; Tehran says no talks unless the US accepts all its conditions. NYT: Iran's hard-liners sabotaged the US peace deal. Trump framed the war as a continuation of the post-9/11 War on Terror. WTI ~$100, Brent ~$104, US diesel record >$6/gal.

trumpWatch.title: Canada trade war: 50% tariffs on more goods effective Sep 15
trumpWatch.detail: Trump issued five proclamations Sep 8 ('Excluding Certain Canadian Products from Importation'); CTV-reported 50% tariffs on additional Canadian goods take effect Sep 15 — one day before the FOMC. Canada's C$27.6bn counter-tariffs (15/25/50%) live since Sep 8. Second supply-side price impulse landing the same week as the Fed.

trumpWatch.title: AI infrastructure bid confirmed — Oracle cloud beat drives INTC +19%, Dell +12%
trumpWatch.detail: Friday's US rally was led by AI-infrastructure names after Oracle's strong cloud quarter: Intel +19.4% to $79.77, Dell +12% (record), HPE +12%, HP +8.4%. Hyperscaler capex (~US$733bn annualized) intact — the fundamental leg under the AI-bottleneck theme while HK names de-rate on rates.
